A '''hyperdrive field guide''' was a series of specialized metal poles used to channel the energy produced by a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], allowing it to propel a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
